comment:
The Contour switch is labelled the wrong way up. Squeeze.cpp:45 configures value 0 as Lin, value 1 as Exp and value 2 as Log, and a CKSSThree's value 0 is the bottom position; Squeeze.svg prints lin at the top and log at the bottom. So the bottom position gives the straight response the panel calls log, and the top gives the square root it calls lin.

The audio detector takes the absolute value of the input (Squeeze.cpp:131), so a negative swing raises the envelope exactly as a positive one does. The gate and audio envelopes are combined with a maximum rather than a sum (Squeeze.cpp:139), which the manual describes correctly.

applyContour at Squeeze.cpp:52-61 has a fourth case, a smoothstep, that no switch position can select.
